learning_outcomes.text: Students have advanced basic knowledge and skills in a selected sub-area of computer science.
Students know practical concepts and applications in the selected sub-area of computer science.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution.
Students have acquired competences, preferably from the field of Applied Computer Science.

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercises, achieving at least 50 percent of points
Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercises
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program. Prerequisites for obtaining credit points are achieving at least 50 percent of the points from weekly exercises and orally presenting the solution of at least two exercises.
